get.summary: Readiness. 200 only when a database query succeeds and the realtime listener is listening.

503.description: The database is unreachable, or live updates are down

post.summary: Continue as: sign in or sign up with a name and an email or phone
post.description: Always issues a new session and revokes any session sent with the request. Web clients get an httpOnly cookie; clients sending `X-Client: mobile` get the token in the body.

delete.summary: Sign out: revoke the current session

get.summary: Public activity snapshot: details, live spots and version
get.description: No session needed. With one, `viewer` gives the caller's own booking. Clients fetch this on every (re)connect of the realtime socket and poll it every 10 s while disconnected; `spots` events with a higher `version` replace its count.

patch.description: Date, time zone and location are locked once the activity has a confirmed booking. Capacity can be raised at any time and lowered down to the number of confirmed bookings.

400.description: `validation_failed`, including a `photoKey` the caller did not upload

post.summary: Create an activity, hosted by the caller

400.description: `validation_failed`, including a `photoKey` the caller did not upload

post.summary: Presigned uploads for an activity photo
post.description: Returns two S3 presigned POSTs, for the 1280 px and 640 px variants, each limited to 2 MB of the requested type and valid for 10 minutes. Upload both, then pass `key` as `photoKey` on `POST /activities` or `PATCH /activities/{id}`.
Takes one spot and creates a Plan owned by the caller. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the original booking with `200` and books nothing more.

200.description: Replay of an earlier request with the same key

403.description: `forbidden`: hosts cannot book their own activity

post.summary: Remove an attendee (the activity's host only)
post.description: Frees the spot at once. Repeating it on a removed booking returns `200` and frees nothing more.

post.summary: Create a vouch, or get your public link (Plan members only)
post.description: A vouch is single use and addressed to one named person; its contact is stored only as a keyed hash. A public link is multi use; each member has one per Plan, so asking again returns it with `200`.

403.description: `forbidden`: not a confirmed member of the Plan

get.description: No session needed. More than 10 unknown codes from one device in an hour lock that device out of every code until the hour ends (`rate_limited`).

post.summary: Open beacon: send once the invite page has rendered
post.description: Recorded at most once per invite per device. Preview bots and the Plan’s own members are not recorded. Always `204` for a known code.

post.summary: Claim a spot through an invite
post.description: The same booking transaction as a direct booking. With a session, the body is ignored; without one, `displayName` and `contact` sign the guest in (web: cookie; `X-Client: mobile`: token in the body). Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the original claim with `200`.

200.description: Replay, or this caller already claimed this vouch

403.description: `forbidden`: the host cannot claim on their own activity

post.description: The link's creator or the activity's host. Vouch invites can't be paused.

delete.description: The link's creator or the activity's host. Vouch invites can't be paused.

get.summary: A Plan: members, how each joined, and invite status (members only)
get.description: Full names, because only people with a booking in the Plan can read it. Codes, links and notes appear only on invites the caller created. A removed member sees their removal and no invites.

get.summary: My plans: the caller's Plans, upcoming and past

200.description: Upcoming soonest first, past most recent first

get.summary: The caller's hosted activities, upcoming and past

get.description: Names, refs, sources and the inviter; never contacts or invite notes (PRD D5).

post.summary: Mark an attendee attended or no-show (the host, after the start)
post.description: A later mark supersedes an earlier one; both are kept.

200.description: The attendee with the new mark

get.summary: A community and its upcoming activities, with coordinates for the map
A public profile: name, "On Velio since", upcoming hosted activities
get.description: Never bookings or Plans: where someone will be is a safety concern (PRD Q10).

get.summary: The host's other dates and "More in [community]", for sold-out and expired screens
